title: Retelling Speech in Conversation
goal: Adapt time and place pointers accurately when retelling spoken remarks on the same day or later
grammar: discurso-indirecto-deicticos in live conversation: when to shift and when to keep pointers

items: I can shift time and place words (*al día siguiente*, *el día anterior*, *allí*, *ir*) when retelling from another day or place.
I can keep *hoy*, *aquí* and *venir* unchanged when retelling remarks from the same day and place.
I can use radio and storytelling vocabulary like *la locutora*, *el oyente*, *la emisora*, *la anécdota* and *soltar*.
